comment: Library for the effect-derived `touched` rule, frame-atom recognition, `chiral` and the origin convention. Every op here exists to make one clause of those rules observable on its own.

tools.name: probe
tools.note: A bare probe: the whole tool model these fixtures need. Every operation here is `tip` and carries an empty tool side, so the frame is declared and never bound - none of these fixtures wires a tool.

ops.name: donate
ops.comment: A donation with frame atoms: the host at the origin plus its three bonded neighbours, all kept exactly as they are so they fix the orientation and nothing else. Only the host and the new hydrogen may be touched.

ops.name: recolor
ops.comment: Sets the element without moving anything. On an atom that already carries it this changes nothing, which is the point: the comparison is against the workpiece, not against the before pattern's slot.

ops.name: reorder_bond
ops.comment: Keeps both atoms exactly where they are and only changes the bond order, so the bond clause is the only reason either can be touched.

ops.name: inert
ops.comment: Names an atom and does nothing to it at all. Nothing may be touched.

ops.name: handed
ops.comment: The only op here that states `chiral`. The replay engine ignores it; the placement engine drops mirrored fits for it.
